Doctor notes possible urine infection with pink urine: “Could just be a, you know, could just be a urine infection,” and discusses pink urine/possible blood; this aligns with possible UTI with hematuria.

Doctor emphasizes pregnancy as a differential: asks about pregnancy risk and says “maybe worth taking a pregnancy test later on, just to confirm that,” and “make sure we're not missing anything else here,” indicating need to rule out pregnancy.

Doctor recommends pregnancy testing: “maybe worth taking a pregnancy test later on, just to confirm that,” and later reiterates “i still want you to bear in mind, you know, have a pregnancy test done,” consistent with advising a home urine pregnancy test.

Doctor says “come back and see me in a few days time, if your symptoms are not getting any better, or indeed if they're getting worse,” and lists red flags: “worsening tummy pain… feeling really hot or sweaty… vomiting etcetera,” covering increased pain, fever, and vomiting with review planned in a few days if needed.
